answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct service slots, where a verifier tracks each vertex to ensure dedicated occupancy. Each agent must reach a falcon speed of light-latency, proving capacity-reservation via direct paths. Signals must withstand a gale of network noise, failing if a raven-like relay is detected. Honest agents pay 1x cost; attackers pay 1,000x for isolated capacity. Slots are locked for 30 days.
